Package com.example.ecolums

Class ProgressTracker

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.ProgressTracker
public class ProgressTracker extends Object
Aggregates individual user activity data into personal and campus-wide sustainability metrics, evaluates milestone thresholds, and triggers celebratory notifications when goals are reached.

Responsibilities (from CRC card):

  • Compare individual stats against milestones.
  • Aggregate all student data for campus-wide impact view.
  • Apply calculation metrics to totals.
  • Check if a goal is achieved and send a celebratory sticker.
  • Provide aggregated sustainability analytics for users, clubs, and campus.

Collaborators: User, ActivityLog, AdminDashboard, Leaderboard.

Reads from the users, activityLogs, campusGoals, and calculationMetrics Firestore collections. Writes celebratory notifications to notifications/{userId}.

Outstanding issues: Campus-wide aggregation currently reads all user docs, which will not scale. Replace with a Cloud Function that maintains a running total in a dedicated campusStats document.

  • Method Details

    • getPersonalImpactSummary

      public void getPersonalImpactSummary(String userId, com.google.firebase.Timestamp from, com.google.firebase.Timestamp to, ProgressTracker.OnSummaryLoadedCallback callback)
      Loads the personal impact summary for a user over a given time range.

      Queries users/{userId}/activityLogs for entries within [from, to] and sums CO2 saved, waste diverted, and energy saved into an ProgressTracker.ImpactSummary object.

      Parameters:
      userId - UID of the target user.
      from - Start of the time range.
      to - End of the time range.
      callback - Receives the computed ProgressTracker.ImpactSummary.

    • getPersonalTimeSeries

      public void getPersonalTimeSeries(String userId, com.google.firebase.Timestamp from, com.google.firebase.Timestamp to, String granularity, ProgressTracker.OnTimeSeriesLoadedCallback callback)
      Retrieves time-series data for a user's CO2 savings, suitable for rendering a line chart on the personal dashboard.

      Groups log entries by day (or week/month depending on granularity) and returns an ordered list of ProgressTracker.DataPoint objects.

      Parameters:
      userId - UID of the target user.
      from - Start of the time range.
      to - End of the time range.
      granularity - One of "daily", "weekly", "monthly".
      callback - Receives the ordered list of data points.

    • checkMilestonesForUser

      public void checkMilestonesForUser(User user, ProgressTracker.OnMilestonesCheckedCallback callback)
      Checks whether a user has crossed any badge point thresholds after accumulating new points, and awards any newly earned badges.

      Reads all badge definitions from badges collection, filters to those the user has not yet earned, then compares their pointThreshold against the user's totalPoints. Awards matching badges via User.awardBadge(com.example.ecolums.Badge, com.example.ecolums.User.OnCompleteCallback).

      Parameters:
      user - The user to evaluate; must have a valid totalPoints value.
      callback - Invoked with a list of newly awarded badges (may be empty).

    • getCampusWideImpactSummary

      public void getCampusWideImpactSummary(com.google.firebase.Timestamp from, com.google.firebase.Timestamp to, ProgressTracker.OnSummaryLoadedCallback callback)
      Computes the campus-wide aggregated impact summary across all users for a given time range.

      Scalability note: This implementation reads all user documents and is intended for prototype use only. Production should delegate to a Cloud Function that maintains a live running total.

      Parameters:
      from - Start of the time range.
      to - End of the time range.
      callback - Receives the campus-wide ProgressTracker.ImpactSummary.

    • getClubImpactSummary

      public void getClubImpactSummary(String clubId, com.google.firebase.Timestamp from, com.google.firebase.Timestamp to, ProgressTracker.OnSummaryLoadedCallback callback)
      Computes the aggregated impact summary for all members of a specific club.

      Fetches the club's memberIds list, then queries each member's logs and sums their contributions.

      Parameters:
      clubId - Firestore document ID of the club.
      from - Start of the time range.
      to - End of the time range.
      callback - Receives the club-level ProgressTracker.ImpactSummary.

    • getClubParticipationRate

      public void getClubParticipationRate(String clubId, ProgressTracker.OnRateLoadedCallback callback)
      Returns the participation rate for a club — the fraction of members who have logged at least one activity in the current week.

      Shown to club leaders as an anonymised metric (no individual logs are exposed) to help them nudge inactive members.

      Parameters:
      clubId - Firestore document ID of the club.
      callback - Receives a value between 0.0 and 1.0.

    • recalculateCampusGoalProgress

      public void recalculateCampusGoalProgress(CampusGoal goal, User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Updates the currentProgress field of a CampusGoal by re-aggregating all relevant user logs and writes the updated value to Firestore.

      Called by AdminDashboard.triggerGoalRecalculation(com.example.ecolums.CampusGoal, com.example.ecolums.AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback) when a calculation metric changes, and periodically by a scheduled Cloud Function.

      Parameters:
      goal - The campus goal to recalculate.
      callback - Invoked with true on success.
